policy.use_mathlib: Direct reuse is verified for the complete interface and its recorded variants, under the stated domains and hypotheses.
policy.needs_work: Further assembly, formalization, source clarification, or verification of direct reuse is required.
policy.rule: A completed exact_reuse review establishes use_mathlib; all other completed reviews require more work or a final direct-reuse check.
policy.limits: This is a conservative next-action audit, not a claim that mathlib lacks an equivalent declaration; composable and partial matches do not establish absence.

checks: Exactly one binary next-action decision for every interface
All prior research statuses, searches, declarations, links, gaps and source data preserved
Conservative direct-reuse rule and explicit reason preserved in every record
Work required does not assert absence; it includes a final reuse check
